tagline: Every insight remembered. Every proof advanced.
purpose: A long-term identity for a mathematical research and learning platform combining provenance-aware reasoning, topological proof-gap analysis, and scoped formal checking.

product_family.name: Remetheon TGA
product_family.role: Topological Gap Analysis and dependency-gap reporting

product_family.name: Remetheon Kernel
product_family.role: Scoped Lean proof certificate and typed-argument checking

product_family.name: Remetheon Chronicle
product_family.role: Time-indexed mathematical reasoning memory and provenance history

product_family.name: Remetheon Research
product_family.role: Integrated researcher-facing conjecture histories and evidence workflows

product_family.name: Remetheon Scholar
product_family.role: Guided learning with learner-specific mathematical history

data_principles: Separate user-authored hypotheses, finite experiments, formally checked lemmas, and independently reviewed theorem claims.
Preserve sources, timestamps, derivation lineage, revision history and explicit unresolved proof obligations when temporal memory is implemented.
Provide research- and student-facing explanations without changing the underlying truth or certification status.

scope_notes.current: Branding overlays existing MathOS and TECT-X code; this change does not introduce persistent memory, autonomous tutoring or new mathematical proofs.
scope_notes.temporal_memory: A proposed future capability; no running memory agent, persistence service, cross-session recollection or automatic versioned mathematical history is implied.
scope_notes.certification: Kernel checks establish only exact supported formal propositions, not faithful translation of arbitrary prose or an open conjecture.
scope_notes.trademark: No trademark registration, domain ownership, exclusivity or independent legal clearance is claimed.

migration_policy.attribution: Built on MathOS research infrastructure and the TECT-X verification toolkit.
